geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the dominant mass from a simple bend into a winged composition that can hold a real public void and improve hierarchy.
Keep the split organized along the long site axis to preserve the dominant gesture.
Create a real central separation so the mass admits a courtyard-like public figure.
Maintain continuity across the split while allowing a clear undercut/connector condition.
Convert the small corner notch into a proper courtyard cut so the ground void becomes public-facing instead of incidental.
Increase the open-space figure to a legible usable court size.
Align the open side with the verified access edge so the frontage reads as an active public threshold.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the generic bar with a split-wing/courtyard-capable primary mass so the form can open a clear public threshold instead of reading as a sealed extrusion.
Keep the dominant mass aligned along the long axis while allowing separation around a usable void.
Use a bridge condition to preserve continuity while creating a legible undercut/public seam.
Open a substantial void fraction so the ground response reads as public rather than merely clipped.
Widen the cave at the frontage side so the access edge becomes visibly inhabited and legible in elevation and plan.
Deepen the subtraction to convert the current shallow notch into a meaningful public recess.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent four-view massing diagram with a readable dominant curved/stepped bar, but it remains too box-like and the section does not yet convincingly express the neighborhood-living brief. The main weaknesses are the sealed or only lightly indented ground condition and the lack of a truly legible public court/entry response to the verified access edge. The silhouette is acceptable as an early mass but its stepped/shifted logic feels more like stacked repair than a program-driven inhabited section. In plan and elevation it is coherent enough to avoid rejection for collision or view inconsistency, but the visible mass still reads as a generic compact extrusion with an upper carve rather than an active street-building with a public threshold. It responds to the parcel reasonably well, but not yet strongly enough to the road frontage and public void invariant, so program_fit_hard_pass fails.
